Noah T: Need urgent exception routing. Candidate for PM II got auto-band 3 but hiring manager approved band 4. Candidate has 2 competing offers and needs sign by 2026-08-05. Can we fast-track?
Ayesha R: Can you post comp details?
Noah T: Manager OK with base $130k, band3 cap $110k. Also discussing $15k sign-on. Candidate wants start 2026-08-10.
Finance Ops: Funding exists in headcount but uplift needs comp-committee + finance OK. We can do provisional sign-on if exec sponsor provided. Benefits cutoff 08/07.
Noah T: Manager says losing them delays product launch. Any quick path?
Ayesha R: Option: provisional offer at band3 top + one-time sign-on now; escalate for retroactive band uplift. Need exec sponsor.
PeopleOpsBot: Created ticket AW-11223. Status: submitted -> committee -> finance. Link: https://internal.redwood/aw/AW-11223
VP Eng: I can grant provisional exec stamp pending committee vote. Proceed with contingent offer language and include 90-day re-eval milestone.
Ayesha R: Drafting offer: "Onboarding 2026-08-10; payroll and benefits effective 2026-08-17 if needed. Base: $130,000; Sign-on: $15,000; Band: provisional band4 pending committee approval; Adjustment retroactive to payroll start if approved within 60 days."
Finance Ops: That split is acceptable. Please add PO request to AW-11223. Procurement will need 48h for PO.
Noah T: Uploaded draft and market comps. AW-11223 updated. Candidate verbally accepted contingent on paperwork.
PeopleOpsBot: AW-11223 update: reviewer assigned (M. Silva). Target review ETA: 12h.
Ayesha R: Thanks all. Will follow up once committee votes.
